_about: Gallery copy for styleboard/index.html (English first, Chinese second). film = demo title; line/line_cn = one-sentence story; uses = what the style is good for.

crayon-book.line: The moon can't sleep, so a little girl climbs onto the roof to sing it a lullaby.
crayon-book.line_cn: 月亮失眠了，小女孩爬上屋顶给它唱摇篮曲。

watercolor.line: Follow the rain from Australia's red desert heart to its green coast in one unbroken painted walk.
watercolor.line_cn: 跟着降雨从澳洲红色腹地一路画到绿色海岸，一镜到底。

ink-wash.line: A swordsman crosses the river on the water and splits the current with a single stroke.
ink-wash.line_cn: 侠客踏水过江，一剑断流。

impasto.line: In a grey, rainy square one red umbrella opens, and a waltz paints the whole plaza in colour.
impasto.line_cn: 灰色雨中广场，第一把红伞撑开，圆舞曲把整个广场刷上颜色。

one-line.line: One unbroken line draws a whole life, then the pen passes to a child.
one-line.line_cn: 一根不离纸的线画完一个人的一生，再把笔交给孩子。

whiteboard.line: How your phone knows where you are: GPS, atomic clocks, and the 38 microseconds relativity adds every day.
whiteboard.line_cn: 手机怎么知道你在哪：GPS、原子钟，和相对论每天多出的 38 微秒。

urban-sketch.line: A park that is only a pen sketch; wherever the wind carries her straw hat, colour follows.
urban-sketch.line_cn: 公园只是一张钢笔速写，风把草帽吹到哪里，哪里才有颜色。

shadow-puppet.line: Ten suns scorch the earth until the archer Hou Yi draws his bow, told with leather puppets on a lit screen.
shadow-puppet.line_cn: 十日炙烤大地，后羿张弓射日。

ukiyoe.line: A traveller walks toward a distant mountain; every shot is a woodblock print, ending in a great wave.
ukiyoe.line_cn: 旅人走向远山，每个镜头都是一幅版画，最后迎来一道巨浪。

papercut-red.line: On New Year's Eve the beast Nian comes to town, and one girl's giant paper-cut lights up the village to scare it off.
papercut-red.line_cn: 除夕年兽进村，小女孩剪出的大窗花照亮全村，把它吓跑。

paper-lantern.line: A single mooncake tells the Mid-Autumn story of reunion and longing inside a glowing paper-cut lightbox.
paper-lantern.line_cn: 一枚月饼讲中秋的团圆与思念，纸雕灯箱层层透光。

risograph.line: A Sunday-morning bike ride through the city — bakery, park, riverside — in two misregistered inks.
risograph.line_cn: 周日早晨骑车穿过城市：面包店、公园、河边。

halftone-dossier.line: A chubby orange cat stands trial for testing gravity and 4 a.m. parkour, and walks free.
halftone-dossier.line_cn: 橘猫胖橘被立案审查：测试重力、凌晨跑酷，最后无罪释放。

pop-art.line: She waits all day for the phone to ring, in melodramatic Ben-Day dots, until she finds it was never plugged in.
pop-art.line_cn: 她等了一整天电话，最后发现电话线根本没插。

woodcut.line: A village spends a whole winter casting one bell; the first time it rings, the snow stops.
woodcut.line_cn: 村子用一整个冬天铸一口钟，钟声第一次响起，雪停了。

swiss-motion.line: A concert poster lays itself out by five Swiss design rules; the fifth is to break just one.
swiss-motion.line_cn: 一张音乐会海报按瑞士设计的五条规则自己排版，第五条是只打破一条。

spy-titles.line: Opening titles for an imaginary 1964 spy film: a chase for a stolen key until the shapes lock into the title.
spy-titles.line_cn: 虚构 1964 年间谍片的片头：追一把被偷的钥匙，几何碎片最后拼成片名。

art-deco.line: A grand hotel, 1930: a bellboy races lifts and revolving doors to deliver one letter before midnight.
art-deco.line_cn: 1930 年的大饭店，门童赶在午夜前把一封信送上顶楼。

blueprint.line: An inventor's blueprint draws, explodes and assembles a cloud-catching machine, and its revision cloud starts to rain.
blueprint.line_cn: 发明家的蓝图自己画出一台接云机器，修订云线变成了真的雨云。

stained-glass.film: The Dragon of the East Window
stained-glass.line: Sunlight crosses a cathedral window from dawn to dusk, waking each pane of a knight-and-dragon tale.
stained-glass.line_cn: 阳光从清晨移到黄昏，照到哪一格花窗，哪一格的故事就动起来。

pictogram-motion.line: All 43 sports of the 2026 Asian Games as beat-locked geometric pictograms.
pictogram-motion.line_cn: 2026 亚运会 43 个大项，几何象形人卡着节拍快闪。

ascii-crt.line: A moon-base AI wakes after forty years to a signal from Earth, and replies by drawing “home” in characters.
ascii-crt.line_cn: 月球基地的 AI 沉睡 40 年后被唤醒，用字符画出“家”来回复。

dataviz.line: A hundred years of summer temperatures, where the chart itself tells the story.
dataviz.line_cn: 一百年的夏季气温，图表本身就是故事。

iso-infographic.line: A coffee's journey from the plantation to your hands, across one isometric world.
iso-infographic.line_cn: 一杯咖啡从种植园到你手里的旅程。

dark-keynote.line: Launch film for Tidy, a fictional app: one buried cursor snaps hundreds of windows back into place.
dark-keynote.line_cn: 虚构 app Tidy 的发布片：被埋掉的光标一键把几百个窗口归位。

rubber-hose.line: A coffee cup chases a runaway sugar cube around the kitchen, 1930s-cartoon style.
rubber-hose.line_cn: 一只咖啡杯满厨房追一块逃跑的方糖。

cel-anime-80s.line: A courier girl rides through a rain-soaked neon city to deliver a tape before the dawn launch.
cel-anime-80s.line_cn: 快递少女骑车穿过雨后霓虹都市，赶在黎明发射前送到一盘磁带。

scifi-toon.line: A jaded genius opens a portal just to buy coffee and tumbles through ever-stranger universes.
scifi-toon.line_cn: 厌世天才开传送门只想买杯咖啡，却穿过越来越离谱的平行宇宙。

pixel-rpg.line: At the final boss door a hero saves the game, and the save screen replays the whole journey.
pixel-rpg.line_cn: 勇士在最终 Boss 门前存档，存档画面闪回一路冒险。

hd-2d.line: The lighthouse goes dark; a girl carries the last flame through a night forest and up the storm cliffs.
hd-2d.line_cn: 灯塔熄灭，孙女提着最后一簇火穿过夜林、爬上风暴悬崖。

microgame.line: A clumsy cadet survives a five-second boot camp, faster and faster, until the boss: landing home.
microgame.line_cn: 见习宇航员闯五秒训练营，越来越快，Boss 关亲手降落回地球。

game-show.line: The history of AI as a rhythm game: models take the stage on the beat, and a report card closes the show.
game-show.line_cn: 把 AI 发展史做成一局节奏游戏，模型踩着拍登场，最后发成绩单。

silent-film.line: A baker's boy chases a runaway loaf downhill, then breaks it in half for a hungry girl.
silent-film.line_cn: 面包店学徒追一个滚走的面包，最后掰成两半分给饿肚子的小女孩。

backrooms.line: A new night-shift hire films their first night in an endless yellow office, following the rules on the wall.
backrooms.line_cn: 新夜班员工拍下入职第一晚：无尽的黄色办公空间，和墙上的员工守则。

brick-toy.line: A brick astronaut builds a rocket from spare parts and flies to a brick moon.
brick-toy.line_cn: 积木宇航员用零件拼出火箭，飞向积木月亮。

paper-popup.line: A pop-up book opens on a desk; a sprite named Pip adventures through paper worlds and jumps out into ours.
paper-popup.line_cn: 立体书在书桌上打开，小精灵 Pip 在纸片世界冒险，最后跳出书外。

tilt-shift.line: Morning rush hour in a town that looks like a model: traffic, trains and tiny people.
tilt-shift.line_cn: 玩具城的早高峰，一切都像模型。

lowpoly-island.line: An island and its village grow tile by tile from an empty sea, each tile a note, into a starry night.
lowpoly-island.line_cn: 空海里一格格长出小岛和村庄，每放一块响一个音符，直到星空。

glass-product.line: Unboxing and close-ups of Aura, fictional glass earbuds, in strip-light sweeps and caustics.
glass-product.line_cn: 虚构玻璃耳机 Aura 的开箱与特写。

living-screencast.line: Clawd, the Claude Code pixel mascot, hops out of the terminal into the Claude app and acts out plan mode, diff comments and self-checks in a one-take screencast.
living-screencast.line_cn: 像素小人 Clawd 跳出终端、搬进 Claude 应用，在一镜到底的录屏里演示 Plan 模式、diff 评论和自检。

midcentury-toon.line: A robot vacuum set up in three steps, told like a 1950s classroom film: place the dock, connect the app, press start.
midcentury-toon.line_cn: 用 50 年代教育片的口吻，三步教你装好一台扫地机：放充电座、连 app、按开始。

hologram-hud.line: An e-bike is scanned into a hologram; target boxes lock onto the battery, motor and brakes, and each spec rolls into place.
hologram-hud.line_cn: 一辆电助力车被扫描成全息线框，目标框依次锁定电池、电机、刹车，参数逐个滚到真值。

engraving.line: A natural-history plate engraves itself: the burin cuts the copper, the bee builds up line by line, and a watercolour wash brings it to life.
engraving.line_cn: 一张博物志图版自己刻出来：雕刀推开铜版，蜜蜂一线线成形，最后手工水彩上色。

silkscreen-poster.line: Three trail posters are screen-printed one ink at a time, then climbed in one long take from noon to dusk.
silkscreen-poster.line_cn: 三条步道各一张丝印海报，一色一刮印出来，再沿山脊一镜到底从正午爬到黄昏。
